meta.title: scatter points in a box
meta.description: The smallest complete graph: one source node fills an axis-aligned box with a fixed count of points. Nothing is connected and nothing is filtered, so the output count is exactly `count`. Every point already carries the standard attributes (P, rot, scale, density, boundsMin, boundsMax, color, seed) whether the graph writes them or not, which is why later examples can filter on `density` without creating it first.
